title: Natural-degree deformation retract from two split functionals
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and C a natural-degree chain complex of R-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Fix j≥0, functionals α:C_(j+1)→R and β:C_j→R and vectors z∈C_(j+1), w∈C_j with α(z)=β(w)=1, βd_(j+1)=α, d_(j+1)(z)=w, αd_(j+2)=0 and d_j(w)=0 (the last differential is zero if j=0). Define S_(j+1)=ker α, S_j=ker β, and S_i=C_i otherwise. There exist a natural-degree complex C′, linear equivalences C′_i≃S_i, and a homotopy equivalence e:C′→C whose forward components are injective. No bases, augmentation, boundedness or nontrivial-ring hypothesis are required.

proof.text: Restrict differentials to S: hd and hin imply kernel preservation, and the complex relation descends by injectivity of inclusions. Define the retraction at the special degrees by x−α(x)z and x−β(x)w, and by identity elsewhere. The identities hd, hdz, hin and hout show differential compatibility. Retraction followed by inclusion on S is identity. For the other composite choose the only nonzero homotopy from degree j to j+1 as x↦−β(x)z; the homotopy equations at j+1 and j are hd and hdz, and all others are zero. At j=0 the outgoing differential is zero by shape. These data give e and its injective inclusion components. This expands the complement and trivial summand construction of Stacks 00MT.

mathlib_searches.query: Split functionals with value one on a vector give a deformation retract of a chain complex onto their kernels
A chain complex with a unit matrix differential coefficient splits off a contractible two term complex and has a smaller homotopy equivalent finite free complex

HomotopyEquiv.quasiIso_hom, quasiIso_inv, quasiIsoAt_hom and quasiIsoAt_inv apply after a homotopy equivalence is built; none builds the complement.
Nine unrelated topology or derived-functor matches; no kernel-complement deformation retract. Also read Homotopy structure and generic shape extension/restriction APIs.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_nat_homotopy_equiv_of_split_functionals
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (C : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℕ)
    (j : ℕ) (α : C.X (j + 1) →ₗ[R] R) (β : C.X j →ₗ[R] R)
    (z : C.X (j + 1)) (w : C.X j)
    (hz : α z = 1) (hw : β w = 1)
    (hd : ∀ x, β ((C.d (j + 1) j).hom x) = α x)
    (hdz : (C.d (j + 1) j).hom z = w)
    (hin : ∀ x, α ((C.d (j + 2) (j + 1)).hom x) = 0)
    (hout : (C.d j (j - 1)).hom w = 0) :
    let S : ∀ i : ℕ, Submodule R (C.X i) := fun i ↦
      if h : i = j + 1 then h ▸ LinearMap.ker α
      else if h : i = j then h ▸ LinearMap.ker β else ⊤
    ∃ (C' : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℕ)
      (g : ∀ i, C'.X i ≃ₗ[R] S i) (e : HomotopyEquiv C' C),
      ∀ i : ℕ, Function.Injective (e.hom.f i).hom
